title: Throttle Profile
description: Configuration profile for throttle/autothrottle behavior on custom hardware

namespace.description: Profile namespace: 'official' = shipped with app, 'local' = user-created, 'community' = shared

author.description: Installation UUID of profile creator. Null for official profiles.

authorAccount.description: FUTURE: Account ID when user authentication is implemented. Null until then.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when profile was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when profile was last modified

extends.description: ID of parent profile to inherit from

abstract.description: If true, cannot be used directly - only as base for extension

matching.description: Rules for auto-detecting this throttle profile

priority.description: Higher priority wins when multiple profiles match

aliases.description: Short names for manual selection (env var, CLI)

aircraftProfiles.description: Aircraft profile IDs this throttle profile applies to

physical.description: Physical hardware constants for potentiometer mapping

potMin.description: ADC count at physical minimum (throttle idle)

potMax.description: ADC count at physical maximum (full throttle)

id.description: Unique detent identifier (idle, clb, flx_mct, toga, etc.)

fraction.description: Position as fraction of physical travel (0.0 = min, 1.0 = max)

simPctRange.description: Sim throttle % range that maps to this detent [min, max]

isIdle.description: True if this is the idle zone

isActiveFloor.description: True if this is the bottom of active A/T range

isDetentGate.description: True if servo should provide tactile feedback here

servoEnabled.description: Does the servo physically move the lever?

detentGatesEnabled.description: Does servo provide haptic detent gates?

mappingMode.description: How to map sim throttle to physical position

leverPositionMode.description: Is lever position driven by a servo or manually?

clampBelowActiveFloor.description: Clamp sim values below active floor to active floor

minDeltaCounts.description: Minimum change in counts before sending new command

travelMode.description: Physical joystick-axis travel span used by the Teensy firmware
